additional_config_cmds: # DELETE MIST GENERATED DEFAULT TYPE-5 EXPORT POLICY
delete groups top policy-options policy-statement evpn_export_type5
delete groups top routing-instances corp_vrf protocols evpn ip-prefix-routes export evpn_export_type5
delete groups top routing-instances iot_vrf protocols evpn ip-prefix-routes export evpn_export_type5
delete groups top routing-instances guest_vrf protocols evpn ip-prefix-routes export evpn_export_type5
# ADD NEW TYPE-5 EXPORT POLICY FOR EACH VRF
# VRF: CORP_VRF
set groups top policy-options policy-statement evpn_export_type5_corp_vrf term 01_default from protocol evpn
set groups top policy-options policy-statement evpn_export_type5_corp_vrf term 01_default from route-filter 0.0.0.0/0 exact
set groups top policy-options policy-statement evpn_export_type5_corp_vrf term 01_default then accept
set groups top policy-options policy-statement evpn_export_type5_corp_vrf term 02_aggregate from protocol evpn
set groups top policy-options policy-statement evpn_export_type5_corp_vrf term 02_aggregate from route-filter 0.0.0.0/0 prefix-length-range /1-/24
set groups top policy-options policy-statement evpn_export_type5_corp_vrf term 02_aggregate from route-filter 172.17.3.0/24 orlonger
set groups top policy-options policy-statement evpn_export_type5_corp_vrf term 02_aggregate then accept
set groups top policy-options policy-statement evpn_export_type5_corp_vrf term 03_ipv6 from family inet6
set groups top policy-options policy-statement evpn_export_type5_corp_vrf term 03_ipv6 from protocol evpn
set groups top policy-options policy-statement evpn_export_type5_corp_vrf term 03_ipv6 from route-filter 0::0/0 prefix-length-range /1-/64
set groups top policy-options policy-statement evpn_export_type5_corp_vrf term 03_ipv6 then accept
set groups top policy-options policy-statement evpn_export_type5_corp_vrf term 04_direct from protocol direct
set groups top policy-options policy-statement evpn_export_type5_corp_vrf term 04_direct then accept
set groups top policy-options policy-statement evpn_export_type5_corp_vrf term reject then reject
# VRF: IOT_VRF
set groups top policy-options policy-statement evpn_export_type5_iot_vrf term 01_default from protocol evpn
set groups top policy-options policy-statement evpn_export_type5_iot_vrf term 01_default from route-filter 0.0.0.0/0 exact
set groups top policy-options policy-statement evpn_export_type5_iot_vrf term 01_default then accept
set groups top policy-options policy-statement evpn_export_type5_iot_vrf term 02_aggregate from protocol evpn
set groups top policy-options policy-statement evpn_export_type5_iot_vrf term 02_aggregate from route-filter 0.0.0.0/0 prefix-length-range /1-/24
set groups top policy-options policy-statement evpn_export_type5_iot_vrf term 02_aggregate from route-filter 172.17.4.0/24 orlonger
set groups top policy-options policy-statement evpn_export_type5_iot_vrf term 02_aggregate then accept
set groups top policy-options policy-statement evpn_export_type5_iot_vrf term 03_ipv6 from family inet6
set groups top policy-options policy-statement evpn_export_type5_iot_vrf term 03_ipv6 from protocol evpn
set groups top policy-options policy-statement evpn_export_type5_iot_vrf term 03_ipv6 from route-filter 0::0/0 prefix-length-range /1-/64
set groups top policy-options policy-statement evpn_export_type5_iot_vrf term 03_ipv6 then accept
set groups top policy-options policy-statement evpn_export_type5_iot_vrf term 04_direct from protocol direct
set groups top policy-options policy-statement evpn_export_type5_iot_vrf term 04_direct then accept
set groups top policy-options policy-statement evpn_export_type5_iot_vrf term reject then reject
# VRF: GUEST_VRF
set groups top policy-options policy-statement evpn_export_type5_guest_vrf term 01_default from protocol evpn
set groups top policy-options policy-statement evpn_export_type5_guest_vrf term 01_default from route-filter 0.0.0.0/0 exact
set groups top policy-options policy-statement evpn_export_type5_guest_vrf term 01_default then accept
set groups top policy-options policy-statement evpn_export_type5_guest_vrf term 02_aggregate from protocol evpn
set groups top policy-options policy-statement evpn_export_type5_guest_vrf term 02_aggregate from route-filter 0.0.0.0/0 prefix-length-range /1-/24
set groups top policy-options policy-statement evpn_export_type5_guest_vrf term 02_aggregate from route-filter 172.17.5.0/24 orlonger
set groups top policy-options policy-statement evpn_export_type5_guest_vrf term 02_aggregate then accept
set groups top policy-options policy-statement evpn_export_type5_guest_vrf term 03_ipv6 from family inet6
set groups top policy-options policy-statement evpn_export_type5_guest_vrf term 03_ipv6 from protocol evpn
set groups top policy-options policy-statement evpn_export_type5_guest_vrf term 03_ipv6 from route-filter 0::0/0 prefix-length-range /1-/64
set groups top policy-options policy-statement evpn_export_type5_guest_vrf term 03_ipv6 then accept
set groups top policy-options policy-statement evpn_export_type5_guest_vrf term 04_direct from protocol direct
set groups top policy-options policy-statement evpn_export_type5_guest_vrf term 04_direct then accept
set groups top policy-options policy-statement evpn_export_type5_guest_vrf term reject then reject
# ASSOCIATE EACH VRF WITH ITS CORRESPONDING TYPE5 ROUTING POLICY
set groups top routing-instances corp_vrf protocols evpn ip-prefix-routes export evpn_export_type5_corp_vrf
set groups top routing-instances iot_vrf protocols evpn ip-prefix-routes export evpn_export_type5_iot_vrf
set groups top routing-instances guest_vrf protocols evpn ip-prefix-routes export evpn_export_type5_guest_vrf
# DCI INTERCONNECT
set groups top routing-instances corp_vrf protocols evpn interconnect vrf-target target:65000:1001
set groups top routing-instances corp_vrf protocols evpn interconnect route-distinguisher 10.254.101.2:1001
set groups top routing-instances iot_vrf protocols evpn interconnect vrf-target target:65000:1002
set groups top routing-instances iot_vrf protocols evpn interconnect route-distinguisher 10.254.101.2:1002
set groups top routing-instances guest_vrf protocols evpn interconnect vrf-target target:65000:1003
set groups top routing-instances guest_vrf protocols evpn interconnect route-distinguisher 10.254.101.2:1003
# DEFINE BORDER-LEAF1 INTERCONNECT SPECIFIC RD & RT FOR EACH VRF TO MATCH ON ROUTING POLICY
set groups top policy-options route-distinguisher local_dci_rd_corp_vrf members 10.254.101.2:1001
set groups top policy-options route-distinguisher local_dci_rd_iot_vrf members 10.254.101.2:1002
set groups top policy-options route-distinguisher local_dci_rd_guest_vrf members 10.254.101.2:1003
set groups top policy-options community local_dci_rt_corp_vrf members target:65000:1001
set groups top policy-options community local_dci_rt_iot_vrf members target:65000:1002
set groups top policy-options community local_dci_rt_guest_vrf members target:65000:1001
# EXPORT POLICY APPLIED TO BGP PEERING BETWEEN BORDERLEAF1 AND EDGECONNECT.
# ALL EVPN TYPE5 ROUTES THAT MATCHES BORDER-LEAF1's INTERCONNECT SPECIFIC RD AND RT FOR EACH VRF IS ACCEPTED.
# REMAINING EVPN TYPE5 ROUTES THAT DO NOT MATCH BORDER-LEAF1's INTERCONNECT SPECIFIC RD AND RT AND ANY OTHER ROUTES ARE
# PURPOSEFULLY SUPPRESSED USING A REJECT TERM IN END.
# THESE MATCHED ROUTES ARE ADVERTISED USING THE ROUTER-MAC VALUE BELONGING TO BORDER-LEAF1.
set groups top policy-options policy-statement ec_sdwan_evpn_export term corp_vrf from family evpn
set groups top policy-options policy-statement ec_sdwan_evpn_export term corp_vrf from nlri-route-type 5
set groups top policy-options policy-statement ec_sdwan_evpn_export term corp_vrf from route-distinguisher local_dci_rd_corp_vrf
set groups top policy-options policy-statement ec_sdwan_evpn_export term corp_vrf from community local_dci_rt_corp_vrf
set groups top policy-options policy-statement ec_sdwan_evpn_export term corp_vrf then accept
set groups top policy-options policy-statement ec_sdwan_evpn_export term iot_vrf from family evpn
set groups top policy-options policy-statement ec_sdwan_evpn_export term iot_vrf from nlri-route-type 5
set groups top policy-options policy-statement ec_sdwan_evpn_export term iot_vrf from route-distinguisher local_dci_rd_iot_vrf
set groups top policy-options policy-statement ec_sdwan_evpn_export term iot_vrf from community local_dci_rt_iot_vrf
set groups top policy-options policy-statement ec_sdwan_evpn_export term iot_vrf then accept
set groups top policy-options policy-statement ec_sdwan_evpn_export term guest_vrf from family evpn
set groups top policy-options policy-statement ec_sdwan_evpn_export term guest_vrf from nlri-route-type 5
set groups top policy-options policy-statement ec_sdwan_evpn_export term guest_vrf from route-distinguisher local_dci_rd_guest_vrf
set groups top policy-options policy-statement ec_sdwan_evpn_export term guest_vrf from community local_dci_rt_guest_vrf
set groups top policy-options policy-statement ec_sdwan_evpn_export term guest_vrf then accept
set groups top policy-options policy-statement ec_sdwan_evpn_export term reject then reject
# PREFER EC1.
# ROUTES RECEIVED FROM EC1 ARE ACCEPTED WITH A LOCAL PREF VALUE OF 1000 TO MAKE THE EXIT PATH TOWARDS EC1 MORE ATTRACTIVE.
set groups top policy-options policy-statement update-local-pref1 term term1 then local-preference 1000
set groups top policy-options policy-statement update-local-pref1 term term1 then accept
# EBGP PEERING TO EDGECONNECT
set groups top protocols bgp group ec_sdwan type external
set groups top protocols bgp group ec_sdwan multihop ttl 2
set groups top protocols bgp group ec_sdwan family evpn signaling
set groups top protocols bgp group ec_sdwan local-address 10.254.101.2
set groups top protocols bgp group ec_sdwan local-as 65201
set groups top protocols bgp group ec_sdwan vpn-apply-export
set groups top protocols bgp group ec_sdwan export ec_sdwan_evpn_export
set groups top protocols bgp group ec_sdwan neighbor 198.19.6.1 peer-as 64533
set groups top protocols bgp group ec_sdwan neighbor 198.19.6.1 import update-local-pref1
set groups top protocols bgp group ec_sdwan neighbor 198.19.6.2 peer-as 64533
name: TR-vjunos-bd-01
